outputPointer 指向结果 URL 或 URL 数组；对象数组可另填: outputPointer selects the result URL or URL array; use itemUrlPointer for object arrays. Use JSON Pointer, e.g. /data/0/url.
轮询使用 GET，地址须与提交接口同源。结果在另一接口时填写 resultUrl: Polling uses GET on the submission origin. Set resultUrl if results use another endpoint, e.g. /tasks/{id}/result. Cancel tasks with the provider. URL media results are supported.

使用 Google 官方服务地址，模型 ID 在上方填写。: Use the official Google service URL and enter the model ID above.
填写完整 POST 地址，支持 HTTPS 或本机 HTTP。: Enter the full POST URL. HTTPS and local HTTP are supported.
按模型文档填写 JSON，提交时自动填入 prompt。: Follow the model documentation. The prompt is inserted when you submit.
generationConfig 可设置画幅等选项（model 以上方模型 ID: Use generationConfig for options such as aspect ratio. The model ID above takes precedence; the adapter handles text and images.
按接口文档填写完整请求，可包含模型 ID 和嵌套输入。{{prompt}} 会替: Enter the complete request from the API documentation, including model ID and nested input if needed. {{prompt}} is replaced by the current prompt. Reference URLs may be entered directly. Do not put keys here.

无需 API Key。在制作台的「配音」中选择已安装的系统声音。: No API key needed. Choose an installed system voice in the Voiceover panel.
保存后可在生成面板选择此模型。启用仅代表允许选择；实际可用性取决于服务权限和模型: After saving, select this model in the generation panel. Enabling makes it selectable; availability depends on service permissions and parameters.

按模型提供方公布的窗口填写，用于提前压缩对话。: Use the provider’s published context window so conversations can be compacted in advance.
文字始终可用。以下选项控制可发送的参考资料，不表示生成图片或音视频的能力。: Text is always available. These options control reference inputs, not image, video or audio generation.
此型号尚未核对，请按提供方说明设置。接口可传入某类资料，不代表每个型号都能理解。: This model has not been verified. Follow the provider’s documentation. An interface accepting a format does not mean every model understands it.
PDF 读取可能包含页面图像和文字，不代表支持 Word、Excel 等所有文件: PDF reading may include page images and text. It does not imply support for Word, Excel or all file types. UTF-8 documents are sent as text.
当前应用限制：单素材 ≤ 12 MiB，文本 ≤ 120 KB。音视频传原文件，: Current limits: 12 MiB per media item, 120 KB for text. Audio and video are sent as original files without transcription or frame extraction.

没有找到此型号，可点击“接入其他模型”。: Model not listed? Choose “Connect another model”.

先添加一个服务连接，再从模型库选择型号。: Add a service connection first, then choose a model from the library.

· 地址和密钥在“服务连接”中统一管理: · Manage the address and key in Service connections
对话使用项目选择的对话模型，未选择时使用此默认模型。切换 Agent 不改变模型: Conversations use the project’s selected model, or this default if none is selected. Switching Agents does not change the model.

请在桌面应用中配置模型，浏览器仅提供界面预览。: Configure models in the desktop app. The browser provides an interface preview only.
密钥仅保存在本机，不进入项目或聊天。测试连接只读取模型列表，不生成内容。: Keys stay on this computer and are not included in projects or chats. Connection tests only read the model list and do not generate content.

移除「{v0}」及本机密钥？: Remove “{v0}” and its locally stored key?
使用 Codex 原生生图。底层型号由 Codex 决定，无法保证或选择 Ima: Uses native Codex image generation. Codex chooses the underlying model; Image 2.5 cannot be selected or guaranteed.
Google 官方连接，无需 fal: Direct Google connection; no fal needed
图片可用 URL、Base64 或 Files API。图片文件不等于任意文档；: Images may use URLs, Base64 or the Files API. Image input does not imply arbitrary document support; this Agent accepts text and project images.
2026-09-08 发布。文字生成与图片编辑使用不同端点；编辑需要 image: Released 2026-09-08. Text generation and image editing use separate endpoints; editing requires image_urls. Connects through fal, not an OpenAI text connection.
fal Queue（Images 原生协议另有格式）: fal Queue (native Images uses a different format)
原生型号 gemini-3.1-flash-image。此处使用 fal 图片接: Native model gemini-3.1-flash-image. This uses the fal image endpoint; editing uses image_urls. Input support differs between Banana versions.
官方未提供通用公开 API。保留模型能力资料，暂不提供假接入或第三方冒充的官方协: No general public API is available officially. Capability information is retained without offering unofficial connections as official integrations.
官方界面中的图像结果；无公开 JSON API 合约: Images in the official interface; no public JSON API contract
2026 年 8 月发布的 fal 后训练版本。此预设支持 image_url: fal post-trained version released in August 2026. This preset uses image_url for the first frame, falling back to text generation without an image. H3 reference-video parameters do not apply.
图像 / 视频 / 音频 · 按任务端点: Images / Video / Audio · Varies by endpoint
2026-07-31 发布。模型支持多模态上下文；文字、参考生成等任务分别配置，: Released 2026-07-31. Supports multimodal context; configure text and reference generation separately rather than assuming every endpoint supports all family capabilities.
支持首帧、尾帧或首尾帧组合，固定音轨可选。: Supports first, last or both endpoint frames, with an optional fixed audio track.
图片最多 9 张，视频、音频各 3 段；合计最多 12 个。视频、音频每段 2–: Up to 9 images and 3 videos or audio clips each, 12 items total. Each video/audio clip must be 2–15 seconds; totals per media type must not exceed 15 seconds.
近期可用的 2.5 系列。文字生成、图生视频、多模态参考使用独立端点；当前预设为: Available 2.5 series. Text, image-to-video and multimodal reference generation use separate endpoints. This preset generates from text. Reference mode allows up to 50 mixed references within per-type limits.
官方型号页更新于 2026 年 8 月。以型号页公开的输入为准；不能因 Omni: Official model page updated August 2026. Follow the inputs documented for this model; Omni family marketing does not imply audio input here. Native adapter not yet integrated.
异步视频生成结果；按原生任务协议读取: Asynchronous video results; read using the native task protocol
不同任务对分辨率、时长和参考数有约束；原生 API 使用异步 operation: Resolution, duration and reference limits vary by task. The native API uses asynchronous operations, not chat responses. Native adapter not yet integrated.
Google Gemini 请使用 Gemini 原生协议，确保 Agent 调: Use the native Gemini protocol for Google Gemini so Agents can continue after tool calls.
Gemini 原生地址填写 https://generativelanguage: Use https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com for native Gemini, without /v1beta or /openai.
文件 · 按型号与文件类型: Files · Varies by model and file type
Responses 使用 input_text / input_image /: Responses uses input_text / input_image / input_file. Raw PDF and UTF-8 text are supported. The connection defaults to gpt-6-astra; adjust to your account access.
原生协议用 contents / parts、inlineData 或 file: Native contents / parts with inlineData or fileData. Images, audio, video and PDFs are sent through native Gemini, up to 12 MiB per media item.
使用 Messages 原生接口；填写账号可用的具体模型 ID。当前不直接接收音: Uses the native Messages interface. Enter a model ID available to your account. Direct audio/video input is not supported here.
根据资料写脚本: Write a script from the materials
DeepSeek Flash：文字、图片；官方未列出原生音频、视频和 PDF 输: DeepSeek Flash: text and images. Native audio, video and PDF input are not officially listed.
GPT-6 Astra：文字、图片；PDF 通过文件输入读取，不支持原生音频、视: GPT-6 Astra: text and images. PDFs use file input; native audio and video are not supported.
